# Providence

> Providence is a multi-state health system offering world-class medical care with human connection, featuring hospitals, clinics, virtual care, and specialized services across 7 states.

Providence operates an integrated healthcare network spanning Alaska, California, Montana, New Mexico, Oregon, Texas, and Washington. The system provides comprehensive medical services through digital platforms like the Providence App and MyChart, alongside traditional in-person care at hundreds of locations.

## Key Topics

- Providence Cancer Institute
- Virtual Care & Telehealth
- MyChart Patient Portal
- Providence App
- Primary Care

## Core Services & Specialties

- [Explore our Health Care Services](https://www.providence.org/services): Comprehensive directory of healthcare services and medical procedures
- [Primary Care](https://www.providence.org/services/primary-care): Primary care and family medicine with preventive care and screenings
- [Cancer Care and Treatment](https://www.providence.org/services/cancer): Providence Cancer Institute cancer treatment and specialist services
- [Heart and Vascular Care](https://www.providence.org/services/heart-and-vascular): Cardiac and vascular specialist care, heart disease treatment services
- [Women's Health Services](https://www.providence.org/services/womens-health-services): Women's health including gynecology, obstetrics, reproductive health
- [Maternity](https://www.providence.org/services/maternity): Maternity services including prenatal, delivery, and postpartum care
- [Pediatrics](https://www.providence.org/services/pediatrics): Pediatric care, family-centered child health services and urgent care
- [Orthopedics](https://www.providence.org/services/orthopedics): Orthopedic surgery, joint replacement, spine care, sports medicine
- [Neurosciences](https://www.providence.org/services/neuroscience): Neuroscience services for brain, spine, and neurological disorders
- [Gastroenterology](https://www.providence.org/services/gastroenterology): Gastroenterology services for GI disorders, colonoscopy, endoscopy

## Digital Health & Patient Access

- [Providence App](https://www.providence.org/services/providence-app): Providence mobile app for appointments, messaging, health records access
- [Virtual Visits: Convenient and Safe](https://www.providence.org/virtual-care): Virtual telehealth visits with physicians and specialists via video/phone
- [Locations](https://www.providence.org/locations): Hospital, urgent care, and clinic location finder across Providence network

## Billing & Financial Support

- [Find Billing Support That's Right for You](https://www.providence.org/billing-support): Billing support, payment plans, financial assistance, and cost information
- [Pay Your Medical Bills Securely Online](https://www.providence.org/billing-support/bill-pay): Secure online medical bill payment portal for Providence patients

## Main Portal

- [World-class health care with human connection](https://www.providence.org): Providence health system homepage with hospitals, clinics across 7 states
- [Atención médica de nivel internacional con conexión humana](https://es.providence.org): Spanish-language version of Providence health system homepage
